description: Raw writes to research.json / tree.gedcomx.json must go through the MCP writer tools, which validate before persisting. The matcher must stay at least as wide as guard_project_files.py's FILE_WRITE_TOOLS + DEVICE_WRITE_TOOLS -- it decides whether the script runs at all, so a tool the script would deny but the matcher omits is a hole the script can never close. `.*device_commit_files` (not the bare name) because Cowork namespaces it `mcp__remote-devices__device_commit_files` and the plugin cannot control the prefix; the leading `.*` makes it bind even if the matcher is applied as an anchored full match. Over-matching is safe -- the script is the precise filter.
